intro_questions: What is the primary function of the engine air intake system?
Name two types of circuit protection devices used in avionics.
Why is ice detection critical for propeller systems?

development.content:
Engine air intake and propeller systems
Windshield anti-icing systems
Ice detection mechanisms

Operational limits and maintenance checks

Emergency procedures for icing

summary_questions: Explain how the windshield anti-icing system prevents ice accumulation.
Describe the role of circuit protection devices in the engine starting system.
What are the indications of a malfunctioning ice detection system?
